## Game Idea: "Astro Dodge"

A minimalist HTML Canvas game where the player controls a small spaceship that automatically moves forward through an endless field of asteroids. The ship can steer left/right and boost upward to avoid incoming rocks. The background scrolls to simulate motion.

**Goal**: Survive as long as possible, racking up distance points.

**Lose Condition**: The game ends when the spaceship collides with any asteroid or moves off the visible canvas area.

1: // Minimalist "Astro Dodge" canvas game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Sound effects
7:   const thrustAudio = new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/mechanical/sounds/mechanical-press-1.mp3');
8:   const crashAudio = new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/human/sounds/water-splash-01.mp3');
9:   const pointAudio = new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/button/sounds/button-16.mp3');
10:   const resize = () => { canvas.width = innerWidth; canvas.height = innerHeight; };
11:   resize();
12:   addEventListener('resize', resize);
13: 
14:   // Player ship
15:   const ship = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height * 0.8, r: 12, velX: 0, speed: 4 };
16:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false, ArrowUp: false };
17:   addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true; });
18:   addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false; });
19: 
20:   // Asteroids
21:   const asteroids = [];
22:   let spawnTimer = 0;
23:   let score = 0;
24:   let gameOver = false;
25: 
26:   function spawnAsteroid() {
27:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 15;
28:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - 2 * radius) + radius;
29:     const y = -radius;
30:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 2;
31:     asteroids.push({ x, y, r: radius, s: speed });
32:   }
33: 
34:   function update() {
35:     if (gameOver) return;
36:     // Ship movement
37:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.velX = -ship.speed;
38:     else if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.velX = ship.speed;
39:     else ship.velX = 0;
40:     ship.x += ship.velX;
41:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.r, ship.x));
42:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
43:       ship.y -= ship.speed; // boost upward
44:       // play thrust sound
45:       thrustAudio.currentTime = 0;
46:       thrustAudio.play();
47:     }
48:     // Keep ship within canvas vertically
49:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.r, ship.y));
50: 
51:     // Asteroid movement & spawn
52:     spawnTimer--;
53:     if (spawnTimer <= 0) { spawnAsteroid(); spawnTimer = 60; }
54:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
55:       const a = asteroids[i];
56:       a.y += a.s;
57:       // remove off‑screen asteroids and increase score
58:       if (a.y - a.r > canvas.height) { asteroids.splice(i, 1); score++; pointAudio.currentTime = 0; pointAudio.play(); }
59:       // collision detection (circle‑triangle approximation)
60:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
61:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
62:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
63:       if (dist < a.r + ship.r) { gameOver = true; crashAudio.play(); }
64:     }
65:     // lose if ship leaves canvas vertically (optional)
66:     if (ship.y - ship.r < 0 || ship.y + ship.r > canvas.height) gameOver = true;
67:   }
68: 
69:   function draw() {
70:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
71:     // background: dark gradient
72:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
73:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
74:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
75:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
76:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
77:     // moving starfield
78:     if (!window.stars) {
79:       window.stars = [];
80:       for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
81:         window.stars.push({ x: Math.random() * canvas.width, y: Math.random() * canvas.height, sz: Math.random() * 2 + 1, v: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2 });
82:       }
83:     }
84:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
85:     for (const s of window.stars) {
86:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.sz, s.sz);
87:       s.y += s.v;
88:       if (s.y > canvas.height) { s.y = -s.sz; s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width; }
89:     }
90:     // ship (gradient triangle with thrust)
91:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x - ship.r, ship.y + ship.r, ship.x, ship.y - ship.r);
92:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0');
93:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0f0');
94:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
95:     ctx.beginPath();
96:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.r);
97:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.r, ship.y + ship.r);
98:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.r, ship.y + ship.r);
99:     ctx.closePath();
100:     ctx.fill();
101:     // thrust when boosting
102:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
103:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
104:       ctx.beginPath();
105:       ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.r);
106:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.r / 2, ship.y + ship.r + ship.r);
107:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.r / 2, ship.y + ship.r + ship.r);
108:       ctx.closePath();
109:       ctx.fill();
110:     }
111:     // asteroids with radial gradient
112:     for (const a of asteroids) {
113:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.r);
114:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
115:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
116:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
117:       ctx.beginPath();
118:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
119:       ctx.fill();
120:     }
121:     // score
122:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
123:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
124:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
125:     // game over overlay
126:     if (gameOver) {
127:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
128:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
129:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
130:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
131:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
132:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
133:     }
134:   }
135: 
136:   function loop() {
137:     update();
138:     draw();
139:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
140:   }
141:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
142: })();

(End of file - total 142 lines)
</content>
